lines.zh: 我沿着屋子绕一圈，例行看看。
lines.en: I circle the house, a routine check.

lines.zh: 我在门口来回走，等人来。
lines.en: I pace the doorway, waiting for someone.
Light steps; don't scuff the floor.
I walk from the door to the window.

lines.zh: 这屋子的地砖，我熟得很。
lines.en: I know these floor tiles well.
I carry something and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 走几步，我就停下来看看。
lines.en: A few steps, then I stop and look.
This building is mine to watch over.

lines.zh: 我在走廊里晃，脚步声很轻。
lines.en: I drift down the hall, footsteps soft.

lines.zh: 从楼梯到院子，我走熟了。
lines.en: From stairs to yard, I know the way.

lines.zh: 我挪到阴凉的地方站着。
lines.en: I shift into the shade and stand.
I move on; there's more to do.
I stand with my hands in my sleeves.

lines.zh: 有客人要来，我得在这等。
lines.en: A guest is coming; I must wait here.
I yawn, then straighten up.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，适合想事情。
lines.en: This place is quiet, good for thinking.
I count the footsteps outside the door.
My work isn't finished yet.

lines.zh: 我望着远处的路，什么也没想。
lines.en: I gaze down the road, thinking nothing.

lines.zh: 我在等下一个来问路的人。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the next person to ask the way.

lines.zh: 我站的这个位置，是最好的。
lines.en: This spot I stand in is the best.

lines.zh: 这里每天都是为了同一个时辰。
lines.en: Every day here is for the same hour.
Hello, what would you like to ask?
I raise a hand and wave you over.
Are you here to take a task?

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，点了点头。
lines.en: I glance at you and nod.
Speak plainly; I'm listening.
Dressed like that, are you new here?
I rub my chin and size you up.
No need for formalities; sit.
I know the roads, and I know faces.
The one you seek is up in the tower.
Ow, why are you hitting people?
These old bones of mine!

lines.zh: 任务牌上写着你的名字。
lines.en: The quest board has your name on it.
I'm only a villager who passes messages.
I stagger and grab the wall.
I've done nothing at all.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我说不出话。
lines.en: The pain leaves me speechless.
I need to put something on this.
My counter has been knocked crooked.
I'm panting, but still upright.
I can't accept this.
Are you hoping I'll do you a favor?
I'll remember the gift; the matter is separate.
Let me see what it is first.
So polite; hard to refuse.
I set it on the table.
Nice thing, but I have rules.
I appreciate the thought.
Don't rush to give it; tell me the matter.
Once I take it, I'll have to act.
Oh, you bumped into me.
Careful, it's narrow here.
The ledger I was holding fell.
Don't push; my hands are full.
This hallway isn't wide to begin with.
You go your way; I'll go mine.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，站稳就好。
lines.en: A bump is fine; just stand steady.
I steady myself on the doorframe.
With more people, this place gets crowded.

lines.zh: 我们互相点点头，就散了。
lines.en: We nod at each other and part.
At my age, I still think of such things.
She works in this house too.
We clear the table together.
She smiles, fine lines at her eyes.
The yard is very quiet at night.
I drape my coat over her shoulders.
We talk about tomorrow.
The lamp lights the two of us.
Days like these aren't so bad.
Time to go back; work tomorrow.
I bend, pick it up, and set it away.
Whose is this? I'll keep it.
Things dropped should be returned.
I put it back on the table.
I'm used to this sort of chore.
I brush the dust off it.
I'll put it in the cupboard for now.
Don't leave it about; it's hard to find later.
I hold it, wondering whose it is.
Tidying up feels good.
This sort of thing isn't my strength.
Are you going to fight?
I back behind the pillar.
I'm not a fighting man.
There are guards here; don't be rash.
I raise my hands, telling you to stay back.
Can't we talk this through?
I hold the object in front of me.
If you really strike, I can only block.
This is absurd; calm down.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，看有没有人。
lines.en: I call out to see if anyone's near.
My legs shake, but I don't retreat.
I move to the other side of the table.
You misunderstand; I'm not an enemy.
I push the stool out in front.
I edge toward the door step by step.
You watch me, and I don't hide.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，怕有武器。
lines.en: I watch your hands, wary of a weapon.
The door is over there; I've noted it.
I step back, you step forward.
The room is small; there's no hiding.
I grip the table edge to steady myself.

lines.zh: 别砸东西，那都是要钱的。
lines.en: Don't break things; they cost money.
I raise a hand before my face.
The closer you come, the further I retreat.

lines.zh: 这里每个角落我都走过。
lines.en: I've walked every corner here.
My breathing is quick; you can hear it.
I glance toward the window.
Say clearly what you intend.
My back is to the wall now.
I'm still standing; that's something.
Don't force me to call for help.
I stare at you, not daring to move.
I block with a stool.
I shove you away and run.
That swing went wide; you dodge.
There's little strength in my swing.

lines.zh: 我踢了一脚，反而自己疼。
lines.en: I kick, and my own foot hurts.
Stay back; I'm holding something!

lines.zh: 我把桌上的东西全扫下去。
lines.en: I sweep everything off the table.
I flail a guard and shield my head.
This shove moves you back half a step.
I've never been in a fight.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，扯了一下。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and tug.
My shout circles the room twice.
I throw what I'm holding.

lines.zh: 我跌坐在地上，还得爬起来。
lines.en: I fall to the floor and must get up again.
You're too strong; I can't hold.
I back up into the cupboard.

lines.zh: 我在这座屋子里站了很多年。
lines.en: I've stood in this house for many years.
The door opens, and I should be here.
Someone comes; I raise my head.
This place is under my eye.
I come out from the back room.

lines.zh: 我一早就站在这个位置。
lines.en: I've stood in this spot since morning.
You came earlier than I expected.
I straighten my collar and come forward.
There's nothing to fear here.
I push the door open to let light in.
I wait here, and keep waiting.
Since you're here, come in.
My sleeve is on fire!

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，膝盖磕破了。
lines.en: I fall down the steps and skin my knee.
I've never seen so much water.

lines.zh: 屋子一震，我被掀到墙角。
lines.en: The house shakes and I'm thrown to the corner.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在门框上，擦着我的手。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the frame, grazing my hand.
Light floods my eyes and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 饿得我扶着柜台站不稳。
lines.en: Hunger has me unsteady against the counter.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我整个人跳起来。
lines.en: The thunderclap makes me jump.
There's no ground under my feet.
